name: smwpatches-pause-menu-patch
title: Pause Menu Patch
description:
When you apply this patch to your ROM, you can create custom interactive pause menus. Give credit to Bio if you are using this patch, crediting me (Nesquik Bunny) is optional.

This version fixes a bug where if you paused on the OW would mess things up. There are also a few other changes. Read the readme.txt on how to use it properly.
